profile.heroSummary: Cybersecurity professional with hands-on experience in SOC L1, Endpoint Security, EDR, SIEM, DLP, PAM, and incident investigation. Skilled in threat detection, alert triage, root-cause analysis, and security operations using enterprise security tools. Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH v12), always learning and building.

infoCards.heading: Hi there, I'm Abhay Raj Mathur
infoCards.text: With hands-on experience in SOC L1 and Endpoint Security, I investigate alerts, triage incidents, and harden endpoints using enterprise-grade EDR and SIEM tools.

infoCards.heading: Tech Stack
infoCards.text: I work across Cortex XDR, Wazuh, Wireshark, Nmap, Metasploit, and Sectona PAM, alongside Python, C, C++, Bash, and Java for scripting and tooling.

infoCards.heading: I'm very flexible with time zones, communication & location
More about me
infoCards.text: I hold the Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH v12) certification and continually build my knowledge through hands-on labs, CTFs, and hunting the latest CVEs and advisories.

projects.title: Raspberry
projects.description: Conceptualized and integrated a Raspberry Pi-based spy system with discreet surveillance capabilities, real-time monitoring, and data collection. Administered remote access, basic logging, and lightweight data collection, then optimized system performance and reliability.

projects.title: Hash
projects.description: Developed a Python-based hashing tool that generates MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and other cryptographic hashes for educational and penetration-testing purposes, letting students practice real-world hash-cracking techniques on generated outputs across multiple algorithms.

projects.title: Website for Water Availability
projects.description: Built a fully responsive website using HTML and CSS to raise awareness about water availability, with organized layouts and clear typography presenting water-conservation information effectively.

skills.cyberText: I have hands-on experience in Cortex XDR, EDR, Wazuh, Wireshark, Nmap, Metasploit, and Sectona PAM, applying MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain to investigate and respond to threats.
skills.programmingText: I'm comfortable in Python, C, C++, Bash, and Java — building tools for automation, hashing, and lightweight security utilities.
